description: Edit these two large pixel art portraits of the same popoto (a round potato-like mascot), the left one with its mouth closed and the right one with its mouth open as if speaking. Turn both into the same new character, keeping each portrait's size, place, framing and pose, with the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour, and the mouth the only difference between the two. The character: a kindly old granny popoto who sells clothes, plainly a different popoto from the uncle: no moustache and no hat, soft silver-grey hair gathered in a round bun on top of the head with a wooden hairpin through it, small round half-moon glasses low on the nose, rosy cheeks, a lavender knitted shawl over her shoulders fastened with a small round brooch, a cream apron with a front pocket holding a pair of scissors, and a yellow tape measure hanging around her neck. Transparent background, nothing else added.
